messages.name: Oceanic Airlines admin
messages.body: Getting 429 with IP-4291, not IP-4290. What's the difference?

messages.name: Leo (Support)
messages.body: IP-4291 is the concurrency limit: at most 10 requests in flight per API key, on every plan. IP-4290 is the per-minute limit. Keep 10 or fewer requests in parallel and retry after Retry-After.
